description: This file contains functions for sending messages, reactions, and polls via WhatsApp using the openclaw plugin SDK, including media handling and logging.

methods.name: resolveOutboundWhatsAppAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the WhatsApp account ID to use, either explicitly provided or default from config.

methods.name: sendMessageWhatsApp
methods.description: Sends a text message with optional media to a WhatsApp contact, handling markdown, media loading, and logging.

methods.name: sendReactionWhatsApp
methods.description: Sends a reaction emoji to a specific WhatsApp message.

methods.name: sendPollWhatsApp
methods.description: Sends a poll to a WhatsApp contact, normalizing input and logging the operation.
